quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road will curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a new lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you can turn right or go straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, the right turn symbol is crossed out, so right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing where the tracks are at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means you must stop. You must yield the right-of-way at the intersection. You may continue when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way roads with a median between them. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the minimum speed you must drive. Do not drive slower than the speed shown on this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and look for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross before you go. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to make a U-turn. Do not turn around where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction. This sign tells you that roadwork is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a railroad crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs only mean one thing: no passing zone. Do not pass other vehicles where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride next to traffic. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means wait for the left turn signal before turning left.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to use when exiting the highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is broken.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A person directing traffic is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A person directing traffic is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a bridge with narrow lanes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: A yellow diamond-shaped sign with black markings:

options.text: Warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
Directs you to cities and towns.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black symbols, and alert you to hazards or conditions ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is not allowed. This sign means no right turns are permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A truck parking area is ahead.
A steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill grade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You may slow down if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin reducing your speed. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that the normal route ahead is closed. You must follow a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It appears at traffic lights where you cannot turn right on a red light. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It appears near intersections. You must not drive into the intersection if traffic is blocked on the other side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must stop completely. Wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that buggies may be on the road ahead. Be prepared to slow down.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road under perfect conditions. In bad weather or heavy traffic, you must drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are driving the wrong way on a one-way street. This is dangerous. Turn around carefully right away.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross at this location. Slow down and watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive slowly and watch carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. Be prepared to slow down.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop at all times. Always let pedestrians in crosswalks go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the left.
The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane ends ahead. You must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does a black and yellow sign with a sharp curve mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of road work.
Slow down because the road curves sharply.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road curves sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves sharply ahead. Slow down as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.
There is a bump in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. This sign warns you to be careful because wet pavement makes the road slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A new lane is being added.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that you may meet traffic coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and stop only if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through carefully without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop and let all vehicles and pedestrians pass. Go again only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will become one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does a yield sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other traffic go first. If traffic is heavy, you must stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers that a playground is near. Watch for children in or near the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you may drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of what?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you see this signal from the driver ahead of you.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane does not continue through the interchange. If you stay in this lane, you must exit the highway. You can change lanes if you want to continue on the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign, which in this case is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow the detour to the right only if it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering or symbols. Detour signs show drivers an alternate route when the main road is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is an intersection ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. Drivers must obey them. This sign tells drivers which direction to go on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: These signs show a change in the traffic pattern or route due to construction work. Follow the detour shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow (to the left in this case). Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Where this sign is posted, you can park for a maximum of two hours during the times shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means there are multiple lanes for turning left. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means drivers from both directions can use the shared center lane only to turn left. Do not use the center lane for regular driving.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs are white and rectangular. You must follow what they say. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed you can drive.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. There is an island, median, or barrier ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road is very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that they cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
A curve is ahead. Slow to 35 mph or less.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. Slow to 35 mph or less.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a curve is ahead. It shows the recommended safe speed of 35 mph for the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means U-turns are not permitted here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they can either turn left or go straight ahead from this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that cars parked here will be towed away.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Be ready for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Be ready for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that parking is not allowed here at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means large trucks are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that lanes are shifting. Follow the new lane path carefully.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and crossing traffic.
Slow down but do not stop completely.
Come to a complete stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and crossing traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and traffic before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop at a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When it is wet, slow down.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is wet, slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance between your vehicle and others.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that if you turn left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic and wait until it is safe to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.
Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you to watch for people crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Farm machinery may be on the road.
When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Farm machinery may be on the road.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for farm machinery in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge ahead at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not be able to safely pass a truck on it. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that the area ahead has low clearance. Watch your vehicle's height.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let other vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you to stay alert. A hazard is coming up and you may need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter this road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and sound your horn.
A bus stop is coming up.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a school zone is coming up. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. These object markers warn you about dangerous objects or areas. Avoid them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
